headline: Malware Incident Halts Operations at Pacific Engineering Production Facilities
body: A malware incident has led to the temporary suspension of several manufacturing processes at Pacific Engineering Corporation's facilities. The company is actively engaged in restoring affected systems and anticipates a phased recommencement of operations. While there has been speculation about a cyber extortion, no official statement regarding a ransom demand has been made. The firm is prioritizing cybersecurity measures to prevent future disruptions.
